experiment_classification.description: Docking performed against user-defined or algorithmically detected pocket without a crystallographic reference ligand.

fluorine_polar_contact.note: Fluorine lacks a classical electrophilic sigma-hole; interactions are non-directional polar/multipolar contacts.

halogen_bond_sigma_hole.mechanism: Directional electrophilic sigma-hole along C-X bond axis (theta >= 130 deg)

halogen_bonds.geometry: C-X...[O/N/S] distance <= 3.8 Å with angle >= 130° for Cl/Br/I; F evaluated as polar/multipolar contact

metal_coordination.geometry: Coordination between catalytic metal (Zn, Mg, Mn, Fe, Ca, Ni, Cu, Co) and ligand donor (O, N, S, P, halogens) <= 3.5 Å (direct <= 2.8 Å)

pi_cation.geometry: Cationic group to aromatic centroid distance <= 4.5 Å

pi_stacking.geometry: Centroid-centroid distance <= 5.5 Å; parallel (θ < 35°) vs T-shaped (θ >= 35°)

salt_bridges.geometry: Centroid distance between cationic center (Lys NZ, Arg guanidinium) and anionic center (Asp/Glu carboxylate) <= 4.2 Å

poses.consensus_confidence_description: Acceptable agreement across scoring engines with moderate rank dispersion.

fluorine_polar_contact.note: Fluorine lacks a classical electrophilic sigma-hole; interactions are non-directional polar/multipolar contacts.

halogen_bond_sigma_hole.mechanism: Directional electrophilic sigma-hole along C-X bond axis (theta >= 130 deg)

halogen_bonds.geometry: C-X...[O/N/S] distance <= 3.8 Å with angle >= 130° for Cl/Br/I; F evaluated as polar/multipolar contact

metal_coordination.geometry: Coordination between catalytic metal (Zn, Mg, Mn, Fe, Ca, Ni, Cu, Co) and ligand donor (O, N, S, P, halogens) <= 3.5 Å (direct <= 2.8 Å)

pi_cation.geometry: Cationic group to aromatic centroid distance <= 4.5 Å

pi_stacking.geometry: Centroid-centroid distance <= 5.5 Å; parallel (θ < 35°) vs T-shaped (θ >= 35°)

salt_bridges.geometry: Centroid distance between cationic center (Lys NZ, Arg guanidinium) and anionic center (Asp/Glu carboxylate) <= 4.2 Å

fluorine_polar_contact.note: Fluorine lacks a classical electrophilic sigma-hole; interactions are non-directional polar/multipolar contacts.

halogen_bond_sigma_hole.mechanism: Directional electrophilic sigma-hole along C-X bond axis (theta >= 130 deg)

halogen_bonds.geometry: C-X...[O/N/S] distance <= 3.8 Å with angle >= 130° for Cl/Br/I; F evaluated as polar/multipolar contact

metal_coordination.geometry: Coordination between catalytic metal (Zn, Mg, Mn, Fe, Ca, Ni, Cu, Co) and ligand donor (O, N, S, P, halogens) <= 3.5 Å (direct <= 2.8 Å)

pi_cation.geometry: Cationic group to aromatic centroid distance <= 4.5 Å

pi_stacking.geometry: Centroid-centroid distance <= 5.5 Å; parallel (θ < 35°) vs T-shaped (θ >= 35°)

salt_bridges.geometry: Centroid distance between cationic center (Lys NZ, Arg guanidinium) and anionic center (Asp/Glu carboxylate) <= 4.2 Å

mmgbsa.method: Physics-based MM-GBSA (GBn2/OBC2 Solvent Model, 12-6-4 Metal Potential & MMFF94)

poses.consensus_confidence_description: Significant disagreement between empirical Vina and physics/CNN scores; verify solvation contacts.

covalent.status: No electrophilic warhead detected in ligand structure

gnina.status: GNINA not installed (requires gnina binary in bin/ or PATH)

fluorine_polar_contact.note: Fluorine lacks a classical electrophilic sigma-hole; interactions are non-directional polar/multipolar contacts.

halogen_bond_sigma_hole.mechanism: Directional electrophilic sigma-hole along C-X bond axis (theta >= 130 deg)

halogen_bonds.geometry: C-X...[O/N/S] distance <= 3.8 Å with angle >= 130° for Cl/Br/I; F evaluated as polar/multipolar contact

metal_coordination.geometry: Coordination between catalytic metal (Zn, Mg, Mn, Fe, Ca, Ni, Cu, Co) and ligand donor (O, N, S, P, halogens) <= 3.5 Å (direct <= 2.8 Å)

pi_cation.geometry: Cationic group to aromatic centroid distance <= 4.5 Å

pi_stacking.geometry: Centroid-centroid distance <= 5.5 Å; parallel (θ < 35°) vs T-shaped (θ >= 35°)

salt_bridges.geometry: Centroid distance between cationic center (Lys NZ, Arg guanidinium) and anionic center (Asp/Glu carboxylate) <= 4.2 Å

mmgbsa.method: Physics-based MM-GBSA (GBn2/OBC2 Solvent Model, 12-6-4 Metal Potential & MMFF94)

poses.consensus_confidence_description: Acceptable agreement across scoring engines with moderate rank dispersion.

covalent.status: No electrophilic warhead detected in ligand structure

gnina.status: GNINA not installed (requires gnina binary in bin/ or PATH)

fluorine_polar_contact.note: Fluorine lacks a classical electrophilic sigma-hole; interactions are non-directional polar/multipolar contacts.

halogen_bond_sigma_hole.mechanism: Directional electrophilic sigma-hole along C-X bond axis (theta >= 130 deg)

halogen_bonds.geometry: C-X...[O/N/S] distance <= 3.8 Å with angle >= 130° for Cl/Br/I; F evaluated as polar/multipolar contact

metal_coordination.geometry: Coordination between catalytic metal (Zn, Mg, Mn, Fe, Ca, Ni, Cu, Co) and ligand donor (O, N, S, P, halogens) <= 3.5 Å (direct <= 2.8 Å)

pi_cation.geometry: Cationic group to aromatic centroid distance <= 4.5 Å

pi_stacking.geometry: Centroid-centroid distance <= 5.5 Å; parallel (θ < 35°) vs T-shaped (θ >= 35°)

salt_bridges.geometry: Centroid distance between cationic center (Lys NZ, Arg guanidinium) and anionic center (Asp/Glu carboxylate) <= 4.2 Å
